The abstract describes building a system, including a RAG-augmented chatbot for audit knowledge retrieval. It says nothing about experiments, and it is mainly a system description. Even so, the RAG component is a developed system, and the abstract does not clearly rule out an evaluation. The rules say to include when the paper proposes or evaluates a RAG method, and to use MAYBE when unsure. This one is uncertain: RAG is only part of the work, and whether experiments exist is unclear. MAYBE fits better than EXCLUDE.

{"decision": "MAYBE", "code": null, "reason": "System paper with RAG chatbot component; unclear whether RAG experiments or evaluation exist."}
